## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of what the feature is.

## 💡 Motivation

Explain the motivation behind this feature. Why should we add this?

## 🎯 Use Cases

Describe the use cases where this feature would be helpful:
- Use case 1
- Use case 2
- Use case 3

## 🔍 Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

Describe alternative solutions you've considered.

## 📋 Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] This feature is not already implemented
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's scope
- [ ] I have provided clear use cases
- [ ] I have considered potential implementation challenges
